title: kate-ui: list the settings fields and apply one edit
summary: settings.rs lists the six EditorConfig fields with their keys, labels, and current values, and applies one edited value by a TOML round trip through kate-core: write the config as TOML, replace the one line, and parse it back. A bad value returns the parser's sentence.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Create settings.rs with the SPDX header and add mod settings; to lib.rs with the dead_code attribute. The keys are fallback_encoding, document.tab_width, document.indent_width, document.indent_with_spaces, document.remove_trailing_spaces, document.ensure_trailing_newline. settings_fields parses editor_config_to_toml line by line and strips quotes from a string value. apply_setting rebuilds the TOML with the one line replaced, quoting a string value for the two string keys, and calls editor_config_from_toml; a ConfigError becomes a sentence that names the key. The test apply_setting_round_trips_through_toml asserts apply_setting(default, document.tab_width, 8) has tab_width 8, that document.tab_width x is Err, and that settings_fields(default) has six fields whose first key is fallback_encoding. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: settings::tests::apply_setting_round_trips_through_toml
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because settings.rs does not exist. After the change a valid value applies, a bad value is a sentence, and six fields are listed.
